summary: A viewport is the area a browser uses to show a page.

blocks.text: A viewport is the area a browser uses to show a page. A viewport meta tag helps mobile browsers use the device width for the layout.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

blocks.title: Let the page use the device width

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `width=device-width` uses the device width for layout.
`initial-scale=1` starts at a normal scale while still allowing the person to zoom.

blocks.text: A mobile browser uses the device width instead of a wide pretend desktop page.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not disable zoom with user-scalable=no. People may need to enlarge the page.
